column1: # Answer key for the local fixture. bin/verify-fixture.sh asserts that every
# row below is actually detected by the pipeline.
# This is the point of the fixture: a clean run against a real site proves
# nothing about whether the detectors work. Planting known defects and
# requiring the scanners to find them is the only way to distinguish
# "the site is clean" from "the scanner is broken".
